[EVENT] User is looking for advice on buying a new amp.

[PREFERENCE] User is interested in the versatility of the Fender Mustang amp.  
[PREFERENCE] User is unsure if 20 watts of power is enough for their needs.  
[EVENT] User plans to try out the Fender Mustang II this weekend.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Fender Mustang series offers a range of models, focusing on Mustang I and II.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Mustang I has 20 watts of power, while the Mustang II has 40 watts.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Mustang II is ideal for small to medium-sized venues due to its 40 watts of power.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Mustang II has 24 presets, effects, and editing capabilities.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Marshall MG30 is a 30-watt solid-state amp with a single channel and a 3-band EQ.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Key differences between the Mustang and MG30 include power, versatility, and size.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested questions for the user to consider when making a decision about the amp.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested options for the user to find out if the music store carries the Mustang II.
